functions.behavior: For each of 12 sidebar build buttons, set BuildMenuGroup from parameter1, count available items, and store the count at the matching index.
For each of 12 sidebar build buttons, set BuildMenuGroup from parameter1, count available items, and set its animation byte to 1 only when the current count exceeds the stored count.

clean_owner.state_contract: Explicit build-menu context, 12 typed button references, stored item-count array, and per-button animation-byte pointers.

limitations: The still-unmapped TutorialSetFlag parent must bind the native button records, stored counts, and animation bytes to this state contract.
